subject.title: [Docs/Question]: Recommended pattern for telemetry-only message lifecycle capture

question: What supported boundary should OpenClaw recommend for telemetry-only CRM capture of raw message lifecycle data across Telegram and WhatsApp while outbound hook reliability gaps remain open?
rationale: The answer affects raw content exposure, plugin trust, outbound safety hooks, and exactly-once lifecycle semantics; automation should not define that product/security contract from source inspection alone.

options.title: Document a cautious trusted-local pattern
options.body: Recommend trusted local internal hooks or typed plugins with explicit WhatsApp opt-in, per-channel smoke tests, and clear links to known outbound-hook limitations.

options.title: Wait for hook-parity fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open until the canonical outbound observer/reporting work lands, then document a stronger reliability contract.

options.title: Route to support only
options.body: Decline repo docs for this CRM pattern and answer individual setups in Discord or owner-maintained plugin docs.

recommendation.title: Document a cautious trusted-local pattern
recommendation.body: Recommend trusted local internal hooks or typed plugins with explicit WhatsApp opt-in, per-channel smoke tests, and clear links to known outbound-hook limitations.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and docs/source history make steipete the best available routing owner for the cross-doc/plugin/channel/security boundary decision.
